---
title: "Minimum wage"
---

The top 20 countries by nominal annual minimum wage. Data cleaned in [clean_minimum_wage.qmd](clean_minimum_wage.qmd); this reads the result and plots it.

```{r}
#| label: fig-minimum-wage
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Top 20 countries by nominal annual minimum wage"
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)

wage_top20 <- read_csv("data/minimum_wage_clean.csv") |>
  slice_max(annual_wage_usd, n = 20)

ggplot(wage_top20, aes(x = fct_reorder(country, annual_wage_usd), y = annual_wage_usd)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4c72b0") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Annual minimum wage (nominal USD)",
    title = "Top 20 countries by minimum wage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
